headline: Aroa Biosurgery Reports 24% Half-Year Revenue Growth on Flagship Product Demand
summary: Aroa Biosurgery achieved a 24% increase in first-half revenue, driven by accelerating sales of its flagship Myriad regenerative tissue product.
why: Aroa Biosurgery is an ASX-listed soft tissue repair company developing extracellular matrix products for complex wound care.

impacts.why: Revenue growth of 24% in the half-year period signals expanding commercial adoption.
